payload.reason: The evidence indicates that BERT was the previous model that achieved state-of-the-art results in various NLP tasks before the introduction of the focused attention model.

claims.text: BERT achieved state-of-the-art results on various natural language processing tasks, such as question answering and language inference.
The focused attention model proposed in the evidence outperforms existing models, indicating it surpasses BERT's state-of-the-art performance.
